title_en: Psychology Made Simple (1/20): Two Identical Bottles of Shampoo
note_en: In 它让我们的大脑走捷径 "it lets our brains take shortcuts," 让 works as a causative: 让 + someone + verb means "make/let someone do something." English has to choose between "make" and "let," but 让 covers both, as in the next clause, 容易让人做出错误的选择 "easily leads people to make the wrong choice."
